name: Arken Document Extraction v1
description: Bounded memory-only text extraction from DOCX (WordprocessingML main story), RTF, PPTX, ODT, ODP and EPUB 2/3 (XHTML) into one structural model with UTF-8 TXT and escaped Markdown serializers, plus bounded CSV/TSV/JSON/XLSX/ODS tabular conversion to CSV, TSV and JSON (cached formula values, never evaluated). No file, network, macro, Office or external-resource access; unsupported, encrypted, DRM-protected and malformed inputs are typed errors.

external_dependencies.reason: Pinned memory-only raw-deflate inflation of DOCX ZIP members into a fixed, declared-size output buffer.
